resources.string: Add an SSH host to sign in with this device’s key.
Choose a host to open its remote shell.
Enter a hostname, username and port from 1 to 65535.
Disconnected. Reconnecting to Windows opens a new PowerShell session.
Use a password or import a private key. Credentials are used for this connection only and are not saved.
Unable to read the private key. Select a key file smaller than 64 KB.
Compare this fingerprint with your server before trusting it. Changed host keys are rejected.
SSH connection failed. Check the address and network, then reconnect.
Device authorization is incomplete. Tap Repair connection to retry.
The SSH host name could not be resolved.
The SSH server did not respond before the connection timed out.
The host refused the connection. Check that OpenSSH is running and the port is correct.
The SSH host key was rejected or has changed.
This paste is too large and was not sent. Paste fewer than 65,537 characters at a time.
The connection is busy. This input was not sent; wait for the connection to recover before trying again.
Saved SSH profiles could not be read. Changes were not saved, so existing records remain intact.
